column2: Use cyclic WQ in legacy RQ

column1: Now that LRO is not supported for Legacy RQ

column2: and we can use a cyclic one.

column1: - reduces the WQE size (smaller PCI transactions).
- lower overhead in datapath (no handling of 'next' pointers).
- no reserved WQE for the WQ head (was need in linked-list).
- allows using a constant map between frag and dma_info struct
Major gain in packet rate of single ring XDP drop.
Bottleneck is shifted form HW (at 16Mpps) to SW (at 20Mpps).
